caption: The drawing depicts a single gray top hat with a cylindrical crown, featuring subtle shading to indicate volume and depth. The hat has a narrow, slightly upturned brim and a light yellowish-brown band wrapped around the base of the crown. The band has a texture indicating it is likely made of cloth, and there is a bow or folded section on the viewer's right side. The main body of the hat is rendered in shades of gray, with highlights and shadows providing a three-dimensional appearance. The hat is centered on a plain off-white or light beige background, which is framed by a thin line border. In the bottom right corner, there is a small inset line drawing of the hat showing front and side measurements, labeled with numbers indicating dimensions. In the bottom left corner, text identifies the artist and a reference number: “Gordon Safter Del. 2594.” The composition is minimal and focuses solely on the depiction and study of the hat.
title: High Beaver Hat
